_doc: Training lessons. aircraft [ids] (optional) = the aircraft the lesson is written for; absent = any; starting it from another aircraft switches to the first id. Each step: text (instruction), hint, done (conditions that all hold), hold (s), any_order (true: also counts when its conditions already hold while an earlier step is current; earlier steps are ticked off; absolute metrics only), warn [{when, say, level}], track [{name, metric, reduce}], record [{name, metric}], gauges [{label, metric, min, max, target, tol, unit}]. Conditions are [metric, op, value]; ops >= <= > < == abs< abs> between. Metrics: ias gs agl alt vs hdg bank pitch throttle rpm flaps wow brake pitch_in along (m past the threshold) cross (m right of the centreline) gp gp_dev dist (m before the threshold) rem (m of runway left), and d_<metric> = change since the step began (d_hdg is wrapped to +/-180). Grades: [{label, source rec|trk, name, good [lo,hi], ok [lo,hi], unit}]. abort: [{steps [first, last] (0-based, while that step is current), when (conditions, all hold), for (s), reason, tip}]: the lesson ends as 'not completed' (reason, what to improve, Try again) when a rule holds for that long; {step} / {n} in the reason are the current step's title / number. incomplete: title of that card.

lessons.title: Takeoff
lessons.summary: Line up, take off straight, rotate at the right speed and climb away at Vy.
learn: Using full power and keeping straight with the rudder
lessons.crash_tip: Keep the nose up after lift-off and climb straight ahead; do not push the nose down close to the ground.

abort.reason: You left the runway during step {n}, {step}.
abort.tip: Keep the nose on the centreline with small, quick rudder taps (Z / X), and look at the far end of the runway.

abort.reason: You ran out of runway during step {n}, {step}.
abort.tip: Open the throttle fully and rotate at 55 knots; do not wait for more speed.

abort.reason: The aircraft settled back onto the runway during step {n}, {step}.
abort.tip: After lift-off hold about 10 degrees nose-up and keep climbing; do not push the nose down.

steps.title: Full power
steps.text: You are lined up on runway 28. Open the throttle smoothly to full power (PgUp).
steps.hint: Full throttle gives about 2,300 RPM. Keep your feet ready on the rudder.

steps.title: Stay on the centreline
steps.text: Keep the nose on the centreline with the rudder (Z / X). The aircraft pulls left as power comes in.
steps.hint: Small, quick rudder taps. Look at the far end of the runway, not at the nose.

steps.title: Rotate at 55 knots
steps.text: At 55 knots, ease the yoke back (↓) and let the aircraft fly off.
steps.hint: Pull gently. About 7° nose-up is enough; do not yank it off the ground.

steps.title: Climb at Vy
steps.text: Hold about 10° nose-up and climb at 74 knots (Vy), the best rate of climb.
steps.hint: Speed too low: lower the nose a little. Too high: raise it. Wings level.

steps.title: Reach 500 ft
steps.text: Keep climbing straight ahead to 500 ft above the runway.
steps.hint: Hold 74 knots. You can trim (Home / End) so you do not have to hold the yoke.

lessons.title: Cruise
lessons.summary: Level flight, cruise power, trim, a standard turn, and climbs and descents.
learn: Holding altitude with small pitch changes
Setting cruise power and trimming hands-off
Climbing and descending by a set amount
lessons.crash_tip: Keep a safe height, make small pitch changes and watch the altimeter and vertical speed.

abort.reason: The aircraft touched the ground during step {n}, {step}.
abort.tip: Keep a safe height: make small pitch changes and check the altimeter and vertical speed often.

abort.reason: You got too low during step {n}, {step}.
abort.tip: Stay well above the ground: level off early and hold altitude with small pitch changes.

steps.title: Level flight
steps.text: Hold your altitude for 15 seconds. Put the nose on the horizon; small pitch changes make big differences.
steps.hint: If you are drifting up, ease the nose down a little (↑). Make a small correction, then wait to see the effect.

steps.title: Cruise power
steps.text: Set cruise power: about 2,300 RPM (PgUp / PgDn). Keep the aircraft level while you do it.
steps.hint: Changing power changes the pitch. Add a little back pressure as you reduce, a little forward as you add.

steps.title: Trim
steps.text: Trim (Home / End) until the aircraft flies level on its own. Then take your hands off the keys for 8 seconds.
steps.hint: Trim removes the pressure so you do not have to hold the yoke. Make small trim changes, one at a time.

steps.title: Turn left 90°
steps.text: Bank left about 20° (←) and keep your altitude. Roll out when you reach the beacon.
steps.hint: Pull back slightly as you bank to hold altitude. Start rolling out about 10° before the heading.

steps.title: Climb 500 ft
steps.text: Full power (PgUp), pitch up and hold 74 knots (Vy). Climb 500 ft.
steps.hint: Aim for about 10° nose-up. Level off by lowering the nose and reducing power when you get there.

steps.title: Descend 500 ft
steps.text: Reduce power to about 1,900 RPM, lower the nose slightly and descend 500 ft at about 500 fpm.
steps.hint: Keep the speed from building: do not let it go over 110 knots.

steps.title: Level off
steps.text: Level off and hold the altitude for 8 seconds.
steps.hint: Start easing the nose up about 50 ft before your level-off altitude.

lessons.title: Landing
lessons.summary: Fly a stable approach on the 3° glide path, flare and land on the runway.
learn: Following the glide path and centreline
The flare and a smooth touchdown
lessons.crash_tip: Fly the approach at 65 knots on the 3° path; flare gently and let the aircraft settle. A hard or nose-first touchdown damages the gear.

abort.reason: You touched down during step {n}, {step}, before the flare.
abort.tip: Set the approach up early: about 70 knots with flaps 20°, then hold the 3° path (two red, two white on the PAPI) down to the threshold.

abort.reason: You got too low, too far from the runway (step {n}, {step}).
abort.tip: Stay on the 3° path: if you are low, add power and hold the nose level until the path comes back to you.

abort.reason: You are far above the glide path (step {n}, {step}). This is a go-around, not a landing.
abort.tip: Start the descent early: reduce power as soon as you are on final, and keep 65 to 70 knots with the nose.

abort.reason: You are far off the runway centreline (step {n}, {step}).
abort.tip: Point the aircraft at the runway and correct drift with small banked turns; the centreline markers show the way.

abort.reason: You floated almost to the end of the runway without touching down (step {n}, {step}).
abort.tip: Close the throttle at the threshold, hold 60 knots and flare gently; do not hold the aircraft off the runway.

abort.reason: The aircraft took off again during the roll-out.
abort.tip: After touchdown ease the nose down, close the throttle and brake gently.

abort.reason: You left the runway during the roll-out.
abort.tip: Keep straight with the rudder (Z / X) and brake only when the nose wheel is down.

abort.reason: You ran off the end of the runway.
abort.tip: Brake earlier (hold B) once the nose wheel is on the ground.

steps.title: Slow down
steps.text: Reduce power (PgDn) to about 1,700 RPM and ease the nose up to slow to 70 knots. Point the aircraft at the runway.
steps.hint: Power sets the descent, the nose attitude sets the speed. Nose-up trim (End) holds the speed for you, so you do not have to keep the keys pressed.

warn.say: Too fast. Reduce power, ease the nose up
Slow. Lower the nose, add a little power

steps.title: Flaps and trim
steps.text: Extend flaps to 20° (] or F7 twice) and trim for 65 knots (End = nose up, Home = nose down).
steps.hint: Flaps down: the nose may pitch. Retrim so you can fly with light hands.

steps.title: Fly the glide path
steps.text: Fly the 3° glide path: aim at the numbers and fly through the rings (two red, two white on the PAPI). Be stable by the time you are 0.8 nm out.
steps.hint: High: reduce power, lower the nose. Low: add a little power. Keep 65 knots with the pitch, the path with the power.

warn.say: High. Reduce power, lower the nose

steps.title: Cross the threshold
steps.text: Keep the path and about 65 knots. Cross the threshold at about 60 knots and start closing the throttle (PgDn) as you reach the runway.
steps.hint: Keep looking at the far end of the runway, not at the ground in front of you.

warn.say: High. Reduce power, lower the nose
Too high over the runway. Reduce power, lower the nose

steps.title: Flare and touch down
steps.text: Level the wings, raise the nose to flare and let the aircraft settle. Hold the nose-high attitude as the speed bleeds off.
steps.hint: Throttle to idle. Rate of descent slows as you pull back gently; do not balloon.

steps.title: Roll out
steps.text: Keep straight with the rudder (Z / X) and brake gently (B) until you are at walking pace.
steps.hint: Nose wheel steering with the rudder. Brake smoothly, not hard.
